notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.4 GR8: during RECEIVE the MCS provides in data-name-5 “the date on which it recognized that the message was complete in the form 'YYMMDD'”, and updates it at no other statement. MessageControlSession#Transfer is the only caller of CommunicationArea#SetReceived (positions 49-54 of the input area, 1-6 of the I-O area), from the date StoredMessage#Complete stamps (yyMMdd) when an EMI or EGI completes the message, or the seed's own date. Probes at --std 85: each RECEIVE SEGMENT and MESSAGE portion of a seeded message set 991231; a message completed in the run read the same date as ACCEPT FROM DATE (261110); RECEIVE NO DATA, a refused RECEIVE (status 20), ACCEPT MESSAGE COUNT, an I-O SEND, PURGE and DISABLE I-O TERMINAL left it unchanged. The witness checks RECEIVE against ACCEPT, DISABLE and ENABLE.

next.reason: 1985: "the MCS provides, in the data item referenced by data-name-5, the date on which it recognized that the message was complete"; 2023: "No communication description entry or MCS-supplied completion date field among candidates; RECEIVE GR covers only CONTINUE completion". The CD entry and its MCS date field are absent. The 2023 RECEIVE candidate treats message receipt without any CD date field, so the requirement is dropped.
